description: ODC (T coverage): TIMER, the type that had never passed through the ODC lane. Mirrors the ITimer block of tests/jobs/tickets-06-sla.json (Action + Description) and adds what only ODC has: CronSchedule, TimeoutInMinutes and the child ScheduleConfiguration (ISchedule, with typed ScheduleItems), which do not exist in SS11 - there the scheduling is only the string Schedule. The scheduled server action reads WfCovTask and counts those that are pending.
